name: Stack Colors
author: Addicting Games
description: Stack Colors is a free mobile game. Warm-up those legs and get ready to stack them colors in this endless runner-style avoider game. In this game, you'll be forced to run as fast as you can through an obstacle course full of differently colored blocks. Your mission is to collect as many blocks as possible while also avoiding the differently colored blocks that are scattered around the field of play. In order to do this, you'll have to move fast and think even faster. Avoid the pillars for they will certainly spell doom. Your only hope at winning enough coin to upgrade your runner is to pay attention and move as fast as you can. This is a game of quick reflexes and the ability to see two moves ahead. Will you defeat the never-ending platform of doom or will you die like all the rest?
